summary: Learning map and paper knowledge graph are layered. (A) New explicit feedback `understood`: saving/useful only raises interest, only `understood` raises mastery, `too_hard` lowers mastery; each paper keeps its latest label per dimension (interest: useful/irrelevant, familiarity: understood/too_hard), seeds count as interest only. (B) Concepts carry an optional type (topic/method/problem/foundation) and a reason; paper-shaped concepts are dropped/rejected; an optional two-enum boundary (background, depth) is sent with the goal and keywords; foundation concepts only when background is unknown. The input cap of learning_path_plan and learning_path_plan_project is registered as 1400 (was 1200) and left owner_approved:false. (D) A second, read-only knowledge-graph view (learning units + the project's saved papers, matched by search terms, prerequisite and similarity edges; no citations). (C) New directions: branch_candidates is wired in; only explicit useful/understood/seed evidence; proposals show their evidence; adding is a click with revision check and undo; turning one down is remembered by phrase.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-layers on top of main 6c0e575. Committed together with the owner's other pending unit (changes/2026-10-06-text-wrap-layout.json) at the owner's request; the two units share index.html and project-creation.css.

budget_impact.rationale: Feedback semantics, the second graph view and new-direction proposals are deterministic and local: no model call, no network, zero tokens. The only model-facing change is the learning_path_plan / learning_path_plan_project prompt (type, boundary): by the conservative all-Chinese worst-case estimate (1.5 tokens per character, a heuristic, not a tokenizer measurement) the input exceeded the registered 1200 by about 127 characters, so the input cap is registered as 1400 (output 900 unchanged); the agent first registered both operations as owner_approved:false and the owner approved the raise on 2026-10-06. The attempt limits (1+2 per session, 3 per project per day) live in code, not in budget.json, and are now documented in docs/BUDGET.md and pinned by tests.
budget_impact.after: learning_path_plan(_project): cap 1400/900, owner_approved true (owner approved on 2026-10-06 in the session: "AI 起草的输入上限我批准了")

open_risks: The raised input cap (1400) is owner-approved, but the worst-case estimate with the longest boundary (about 1447 tokens, by the test's own +150 tolerance) is still above it; the gateway reserves the cap and does not refuse by input length.
No real model call was made: whether the new prompt yields typed concepts is unknown.
The growth strength threshold (0.25) has no data behind it; on a real library 'ready' proposals may be rare (the tests need three explicit responses and very similar texts).
The second view's canvas clicks (paper, unit) are not covered by an automated test; only the layout, style acceptance, view switching and stale-render guards are.
The review fixes were not re-read by a reviewer; the Tauri window was not clicked through.

Citation edges are not included: the owner decided on 2026-10-06 not to build them (OpenAlex has almost no references for recent arXiv papers); Connected Papers links are the replacement and are a separate change.
